resources.string: Guide the flow. Surround your rivals.
Classic rules · Six teams · Widescreen maps
Choose a map for your next six-team match.
Tap the room name to rename it. The host controls match settings.
The match opens automatically when the host starts.
Touch and drag to guide your particles around obstacles.
Use up to five touch points at once to split your forces.
Convert every rival particle to your team colour to win.

All model APIs are disabled in this preview. You control the selected team; other teams use local AI. Spectating uses local AI for every team. Raised rocks, ice and roots block movement; dark ground and shallow water are passable. Start begins the three-second countdown. Spawns change each match.
